# Course materials {.unnumbered}

Assignments, slides, readings, and quizzes are on **Canvas**, and announcements and discussion are on **Microsoft Teams** (the link is on Canvas). This page collects the course staff, the class schedule, and assignment deadlines in one place. Dates are subject to change; changes are announced in class, on Canvas, and on Teams.
